rules: Author specimens and complete requested projection by source reasoning; compiler output, if collected later, is only observation and cannot set expected values.

Names are syntax texts, not checker symbols. Referenced names deliberately include identifiers from deferred bodies and parameter bindings, remove only statement declaredNames and recognized member/property keys.
executesOnLoad is historical predicate outcome, not an exhaustive proof of JavaScript runtime effects. All-inline-type import/export may loadsModule maybe while executesOnLoad remains true.
Every fixture is one parseable statement with independently counted line coordinates. Optional fields absent are distinguished from empty bindings/false.
No SDK declaration or compiler Program is needed for this source-only outline boundary. Pinned parser identity is TypeScript5.9.3 but not executed here.
Negative controls are false predicate branches, not admission refusals. Reuse N09-outline-syntax-error as syntax-prerequisite refusal only; do not claim complete recovered outline.
Export-star entries freeze only syntactic load behavior; parent-reported resolution arbitration at issuecomment-6235210936 is separate and no canonical endpoint expectation is imported.

prior_case_relationship.P09-outline-logical-set: Existing simple variable/function and digest relations remain valid narrow observations; this matrix adds missing class/load/binding discriminators.
prior_case_relationship.N09-outline-syntax-error: Existing hasSyntaxErrors true and no-complete-classification refusal projection retained; no generated recovered statement golden authored.
prior_case_relationship.profile: source-outline; no qualified/static profile default imported

projection_exclusions: digest only; optional field absence separately exact
No class/type/runtime resolution, admission status or final impact verdict
